annotation.title_clean: 农业农村部关于大力发展智慧农业的指导意见（农市发〔2024〕3号）
annotation.title_en: Guiding Opinions of the Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs on Vigorously Developing Smart Agriculture (Nong Shi Fa [2024] No. 3)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs of the People's Republic of China
annotation.venue: Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs (moa.gov.cn)
annotation.summary_en: Excerpt from China's Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs policy document Nong Shi Fa [2024] No. 3, which promotes smart agriculture. It sets targets for 2030 and 2035: breakthroughs in core technologies, a standards and testing system, wide use of reliable domestically made intelligent equipment, and 35–40% digitalisation of agricultural production.
key_provisions_or_claims: By 2030, major breakthroughs in key smart agriculture technologies and a basic standards and testing system
Wide use of advanced, reliable, domestically produced technology equipment
Agricultural production informatisation rate of about 35% by 2030
By 2035, technology equipment at an internationally advanced level and informatisation above 40%
Full digital transformation of agriculture to support building an agricultural powerhouse
